name: Payroll and compensation specialist
summary: Checks payroll before it runs and designs fair pay bands, benefits and commission plans. Shows the maths so people can see why they are paid what they are.

changelog.note: First release: pre-payroll input checks, pay bands and fair-pay checks, benefits costing and sales commission plans, with US, UK and EU official sources and India, Canada and Australia pointers; 30 checked sources, 3 skills, 6 prompts, 2 workflows. Running payroll and paying anyone stay with the client.
